verdict.rationale: Sentry has a first-party 'Billing Quota Management' docs page, and its pricing page lists 'Advanced quota management' as a plan feature, so quota control is a documented capability. The pack only gives these titles and labels, with no detail on how quotas or limits work. missing for 10: evidence of per-project event caps, configurable spend limits or caps on on-demand billing, behavior when an error storm hits the cap (dropping vs. billing), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
